name: Lateral Sled Drag
description: Sled drag in a sideways athletic stance — builds adductor/abductor strength and endurance for stance work, pivots, and takedown defense.
instructions_excerpt: Face sideways to a sled with a strap in one hand. In a wide athletic stance, shuffle laterally for 10-20 yards, dragging the sled. Turn and repeat on the other side. Use moderate load you can keep moving steadily.

name: Light Yoga Flow (10 min)
description: Low-intensity full-body flow — active recovery session.
instructions_excerpt: Flow through a gentle sequence: cat-cow (5 breaths) → downward dog → low lunge each side → seated twist each side → child's pose → supine spinal twist each side → legs up the wall (2 min).

name: Long Steady Paddle-Erg (Zone 2)
description: Extended zone-2 paddling — aerobic base for open-water paddlers and distance rowers.
instructions_excerpt: Paddle erg 30-60 minutes at conversational pace (Zone 2, 60-70% max HR). Keep stroke rate even.

name: Long-Run Aerobic Base
description: Conversational long run — the cornerstone of any aerobic-sport base.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 10 min jog. Run continuously at conversational pace for 60-150 min. Walk breaks allowed.

name: Map Running Short-Course
description: Short map-based run — orienteering and rogaine skill under light fatigue.
instructions_excerpt: Get a local park map + compass. Run a 30-60 min course visiting control points. Alternate route-choice pairs.

name: Monkey-Bar Traverse
description: Hand-over-hand monkey-bar traverse — OCR grip and shoulder endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Traverse monkey bars hand over hand, alternating grips if possible. 3-5 full traverses.

name: Mountaineer Pace Clock (Deliberate-Breath Walk)
description: Rest-step + breath-cadence walk drill — the skill that lets you go all day at altitude without blowing up.
instructions_excerpt: Walk slowly. Lock the trailing leg briefly to let it rest (rest-step). Inhale-exhale cycle on every step pair. Keep it slow; let it become automatic.

name: Mounted-Trail Breath Drill
description: Slow cyclical breath drill — mindful calm-state practice for trail riders and endurance rides.
instructions_excerpt: Inhale 4s, exhale 6s with relaxed shoulders. 5-10 min. Perform seated or on horseback at halt.

name: Open-Water Sighting Stroke Drill
description: Freestyle stroke with head-lift sighting — open-water swimming specific.
instructions_excerpt: Swim freestyle at moderate pace. Every 4-6 strokes, lift head briefly to sight forward without breaking stroke. 4-8 x 50m.

name: Open-Water Swim Aerobic Set
description: Threshold-pace continuous swim — the aerobic engine for open-water and triathlon swim.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 200m. Swim continuously at threshold effort (slightly faster than conversational) for 20-40 min. Alternate breathing sides every 3-5 strokes. Cool down 100m.

name: Orienteer Compass-and-Map Jog
description: Map-reading jog at easy aerobic pace — integrates navigation skill with steady cardio.
instructions_excerpt: Jog 20-45 min at conversational pace while navigating a small park using a map and compass. Relocate every 200 m.

name: Orienteering Compass-Run Drill
description: Short interval running at bearing-hold pace — sport-specific to map-running.
instructions_excerpt: Set a visible marker 100-150 m away. Run at threshold-pace while keeping eye-line on the marker (not the ground). 6-8 reps, walking return.

name: Paddle Erg Intervals
description: Paddle ergometer interval training — the most sport-specific conditioning available indoors for paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 5 minutes. Perform 6-10 intervals of 60-90 seconds at 85-90% effort with equal rest. Cool down 5 minutes.

name: Partner Kiai Breathing Drill
description: Short powerful kiai exhale on strike cadence — trains combat-breath and core brace.
instructions_excerpt: Facing a partner or target, exhale sharply with a kiai on each strike. 10 bursts, 5 s rest between. Focus on core brace simultaneous with exhale.

name: Pilates Hundred
description: Classical Pilates core primer — sustained core activation with breath coordination.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine. Lift head and shoulders, extend legs to a tabletop or low hover. Arms hover palms down beside hips. Pulse arms 100 times while inhaling for 5 and exhaling for 5.

name: Pilates Hundred Leg-Extended
description: Classic pilates hundred at extended-leg position — core stability with breath pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Supine. Legs at 45 degrees, head/shoulders lifted. Pulse arms 5 inhales + 5 exhales for 10 rounds (= 100).

name: Posting Trot Squat Intervals
description: Rhythmic shallow squat simulating a posting trot — cardiovascular + rider-specific leg.
instructions_excerpt: Shallow squat up/down at a steady tempo matching a posting trot (about 60 bpm). 2-min bouts with 1-min rest. 4-6 rounds.

name: Progression Run
description: Running session that builds pace throughout — ideal for multi-sport and distance-race prep.
instructions_excerpt: Run 45-75 min. First third easy, second third moderate, final third tempo. Don't blow up in the last 10 min.

name: Prone Paddle on Stability Ball
description: Prone arm-stroke simulation on a stability ball — trains balance and paddle endurance for surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Lie prone with the stability ball under the hips, feet lightly touching the floor or extended. Perform alternating arm strokes mimicking surf paddling. 30-60 seconds per bout.

name: Prone Swim Pull (PVC Bar)
description: Prone-position simulated pull with a PVC bar — reinforces swim-stroke pattern without water.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench with upper body off the edge. Hold a light PVC bar overhead with straight arms. Pull the bar down, hands tracing the outside of the torso, finishing at the hips. Return overhead.

name: Prone Swim Pull with Mini-Band
description: Banded prone swim-pull drill — freestyle-specific lat recruitment.
instructions_excerpt: Lie face-down on a bench, upper body off the edge. Hold a looped mini-band between hands overhead. Pull the band out and down to the hips, then return. 12-15 reps.

name: PVC Fly-Casting Endurance
description: Simulated fly-casting with a PVC dowel — builds the specific shoulder endurance and elbow control of long days on the river.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a PVC dowel like a fly rod. Perform controlled 10-and-2 casting strokes with crisp stops. 30-60 seconds per side. Focus on forearm/wrist-driven motion, not big arm sweeps.

name: PVC Sailing Pull (Bent-Over)
description: Bent-over pull simulating the mainsheet/jib-sheet trim under load. Upper-back endurance for sailors.
instructions_excerpt: Stand hinged at the hips, a light PVC bar or band looped under one foot. Pull the resistance toward the chest with a rowing motion — mimic the rhythm of trimming a sheet. 15-25 reps per side.

name: Quadrupedal Crawl (QM)
description: Low crawl with contralateral hand/foot movement — fundamental parkour + movement-culture pattern.
instructions_excerpt: Start on hands and feet (not knees), hips low. Crawl forward moving opposite hand and opposite foot together. Maintain low hips and quiet feet.

name: Rolling Hill Tempo (Bike)
description: Continuous rolling-hills ride at tempo — specific aerobic-power for gravel/road/gravel-racing.
instructions_excerpt: Ride a rolling-hill loop for 45-90 min, holding tempo effort (80-85% threshold). Sit for flats, stand for steep rollers. Smooth transitions.

name: Rope Skip (Speed Rope)
description: Speed jump rope — calf and ankle reactive conditioning, cheap and travel-friendly for any team-sport athlete.
instructions_excerpt: With a speed rope, skip for 30-60 sec rounds. Stay on the balls of the feet, small hops, fast rope tempo. 3-5 rounds.

name: Rower + Push-Up EMOM
description: EMOM (every minute on the minute) mixing rowing erg calories with push-ups — conditioning + antagonist balance.
instructions_excerpt: Set a 10-20 minute EMOM. Alternate minutes: minute 1 — 15-20 cal row; minute 2 — 12-15 push-ups. Rest the remainder of each minute.

name: Rowing Erg Intervals
description: Full-body cardio without joint impact — good option on climbing rest days.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up for 3 minutes easy. Perform 4-6 rounds of 500m hard (RPE 7-8) with 90-120s easy rowing between. Cool down 3 minutes.

name: Rucking (Zone-2 Walking with Pack)
description: Walking under a loaded pack — specific to mountaineering and multi-day backpacking.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a weighted pack (20-30% bodyweight). Walk at Zone-2 pace for 30-90 minutes on varied terrain. Keep posture tall; adjust pack if it swings.

name: Sandbag Over Obstacle (OCR)
description: Sandbag-carry to hop-over drill — OCR-specific loaded-traverse practice.
instructions_excerpt: Shoulder a 30-50 lb sandbag. Walk 30 m. Lift over a knee-height obstacle, step-over, continue. Alternate shoulders. 4-6 loops.

name: Seated Box Trainer Tempo (E-Bike Sim)
description: Steady moderate-resistance trainer session — base fitness for e-bike riders managing assist use.
instructions_excerpt: Ride trainer at moderate resistance. 30-60 min. Alternate 10-min seated with 5-min standing. Keep effort near the assist-handover line.

name: Shadow Boxing Conditioning
description: Shadow boxing in round structure — full-body conditioning with zero equipment, perfect for pre-event or home training.
instructions_excerpt: Shadowbox for 3 minutes, focusing on footwork, combinations, and defensive movement. 1 minute rest. Mix tempos — moderate for 2 minutes, max output for the final 30 seconds. 3-5 rounds.

name: Shadow Strike Flow (Unloaded)
description: Continuous shadow-boxing-style strike flow with footwork — cardiovascular + combat rhythm for any striking art.
instructions_excerpt: Move and strike through 2-3 min rounds: punches, hand traps, kicks, evasions. Keep it fluid. 3-5 rounds with 60 sec rest.

name: Shoulder Distraction Hang
description: Passive hang for shoulder decompression — the single best recovery tool for paddle-sore shoulders.
instructions_excerpt: Hang from a pull-up bar with relaxed shoulders (let the shoulders shrug up). Breathe. 20-45 seconds per hang.

name: Shuttle Run Conditioning (Suicides)
description: Court/field shuttle conditioning — the standard team-sport anaerobic-capacity builder.
instructions_excerpt: Set cones at 10, 20, 30, and 40 yards from the start. Sprint to first cone and back, second cone and back, and so on. Rest equal to work. 3-5 rounds.

name: Ski-Erg Intervals
description: Ski-erg intervals — upper-body pulling conditioning that crosses over strongly to paddling.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 5 minutes. Perform 5-8 intervals of 60 seconds at 85% effort, 60 seconds rest. Cool down 5 minutes.

name: Ski-Touring Skin-Track Step
description: Uphill stride with heel-lift posture — specific to ski-touring skin-track cadence.
instructions_excerpt: On a treadmill or hill at 10-15% grade, walk/stride with feet flat, torso slightly forward, 20-30 min.

name: Sled Push (Hill Simulation)
description: Sled push walk — loaded eccentric-quad-free effort that transfers to cycling climbs.
instructions_excerpt: Push a loaded sled 20-40 m at steady pace. Keep hips low, arms extended, steady breath. Walk back. 4-6 reps.

name: Sled Push 3-Min Round
description: Loaded sled push for a 3-minute round — alactic/lactic conditioning that matches a round structure and builds drive-phase leg power.
instructions_excerpt: Push a moderately loaded sled for short (10-20 yd) bursts. Walk back. Continue for 3 minutes. 1 minute rest. 3-4 rounds. Load should allow steady effort, not failure.

name: Slide Board Lateral
description: Slide-board lateral push-offs — off-ice specific training for hockey and lateral deceleration for all team sports.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a slide board with booties. Push off one end with the inside foot, glide to the other side, and absorb with the outside leg. Continuous sliding for 30-60 sec per set.

name: Slide-Board Lateral Skate
description: Slide-board push — speciality skating-stride prep; builds lateral hip power and glide endurance.
instructions_excerpt: Stand on a slide board with booties. Push off one foot to glide laterally to the opposite bumper, catching weight on the other foot. Continue side-to-side for 30-60 seconds.

name: Slide-Board Skate Shuffle
description: Slide-board lateral pushes — the cleanest dryland replica of the skate-ski and XC skate stride.
instructions_excerpt: On a slide board, push off one booty and glide to the far bumper, catch with the opposite foot, push back. 30-60 sec sets. Keep hips low, chest over knees.

name: Snowshoe Deep-Snow Post-Hole Sim
description: High-knee stepping through resistance — simulates breaking trail in deep snow with snowshoes.
instructions_excerpt: March in place with exaggerated knee-lift to hip height for 60-90s. Optionally step through resistance band wrapped around ankles.

name: Spearfishing Breath-Tread Sim
description: Treading-water-style breath hold — spearfishing-specific.
instructions_excerpt: In chest-deep water, tread water with calm scull motion while holding breath for 15-30s. 4-6 rounds.

name: Spearfishing Finning Intervals
description: Interval finning drill — spearfishing-specific kick endurance.
instructions_excerpt: In a pool with long fins, fin 50m at steady pace. Rest 30s. Repeat 8-12 times.

name: Sprawl
description: Grappling / team-sport defensive drop — burpee-like movement that builds conditioning and takedown defense.
instructions_excerpt: From standing, drop into a plank position with hips flat on the floor, shoot legs straight back. Quickly hop feet forward and return to standing.

name: Sprawl-to-Shot Drill
description: Alternating sprawl and shot drill — mirrors wrestling's stance-change conditioning in a repeatable training block.
instructions_excerpt: From a wrestling stance, sprawl (hips to floor, legs back), then recover and shoot a penetration step forward. Reset. Repeat at a steady pace for 30-45 seconds. 4-6 bouts with 1 min rest.

name: Stair Sprint Intervals (Weighted)
description: Weighted stair sprint — aerobic-power driver for technical and expedition mountaineering.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a light pack (5-15 kg). Sprint up a long staircase at a pace you can sustain for 30-60s, walk down to recover. 6-10 intervals. Drive arms, maintain upright posture.

name: Static Apnea Walk
description: Walking breath-hold — practical transfer for spearfishing, freediving, water polo chase.
instructions_excerpt: Inhale fully. Hold breath. Walk at an easy pace until the first strong urge to breathe. Recover 60s. 5-8 rounds. Never push to blackout. Progress time slowly.

name: Supine Finning Kick Drill
description: Dryland finning drill — hip-flexor and glute endurance for spearfishing and long fin/monofin swims.
instructions_excerpt: Lie supine on a mat, hands under glutes, legs straight and slightly elevated. Alternate long slow kicks from the hip — like finning with a monofin — for 30-60 seconds.

name: Swim Bench Paddle Intervals
description: Swim-specific ergometer or cable pull intervals — anaerobic transfer to freestyle/paddle pull.
instructions_excerpt: On a paddle-erg or cable crossover, perform a swim-stroke pull at hard effort for 30s. 60s recovery. 6-10 rounds.

name: Swim Cord Catch Pull
description: Single- or double-arm swim cord pulls from paddle-specific catch position — endurance for paddlers and surfers.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor swim cords at chest height. Lean forward, arms extended overhead as at the catch. Pull cords past the hips with the torso engaged. Control the return.

name: Swim-Cord Pulls
description: Dryland mimicry of the freestyle pull using surgical tubing / swim cords.
instructions_excerpt: Anchor swim cords at chest height. Stand facing away with handles in hands, arms extended. Pull through a full stroke cycle — catch, pull, finish — with controlled tempo. 15-30 seconds per set.

name: Swim-Run Transition Brick
description: Short swim followed immediately by a short run — trains swimrun transitions.
instructions_excerpt: Swim 200-400 m (pool or open water). Exit water, pull on shoes, run 1-2 km. Repeat 3-5 brick cycles.

name: Swimrun Wetsuit Transition Drill
description: Quick swim-to-run transition practice — specific to swimrun races where athletes keep wetsuit on.
instructions_excerpt: Swim 25-50 m in shallow water, exit, immediately run 100 m, re-enter. 4-6 transitions.

name: Tabata Paddle Pull
description: 4-minute tabata on the paddle erg or swim cords — high-intensity pulling for short-course paddlers.
instructions_excerpt: 8 rounds: 20 seconds max effort paddle pull, 10 seconds rest. 4 minutes total work.

name: Technical Trail Run (Short)
description: Short rock-and-root trail run at steady effort — specific skill + aerobic work for trail/fell/mountain running.
instructions_excerpt: On technical singletrack, run 20-45 min at steady conversational pace. Look 3-5 m ahead. React, don't brake.

name: Tempo Run (100m)
description: Sub-max 70-80% tempo runs — aerobic capacity and recovery between sessions for field-sport athletes.
instructions_excerpt: On a track or open field, run 100m at roughly 70-80% max. Walk back. Repeat 8-12 times. Focus on smooth mechanics — not max speed.

name: Tempo Run (Threshold)
description: Threshold-effort tempo run — classic engine builder for all distance running.
instructions_excerpt: Warm up 15 min. Run 20-40 min at threshold pace (hard but can speak in 2-3 word phrases). Cool down 10 min.

name: Uphill Hill Repeats (Running or Hiking)
description: Repeat efforts up a hill — aerobic-power primer for mountaineering and fastpacking.
instructions_excerpt: Find a hill that takes 45-90 seconds to ascend at a hard effort. Go up at ~90% effort. Walk down to recover. 6-10 reps.

name: Uphill Treadmill Ruck
description: Weighted treadmill walk at 10-15% grade — substitute for pack hiking on weather or city days.
instructions_excerpt: Load a pack to 15-30% bodyweight. Set treadmill to 10-15% grade at a walking pace that lets you complete 30-60 min without running. Arms swing naturally.

name: Walking (Low-Intensity Zone 2)
description: Low-impact aerobic recovery — the most undervalued recovery tool.
instructions_excerpt: Walk at a pace where conversation is comfortable but steady (Zone 2, ~60-70% max HR). 20-45 minutes on flat or gently rolling terrain.

name: Wall Ball Shot
description: Full-body conditioning movement — squat + press combo with a med ball.
instructions_excerpt: Hold a med ball at chest height. Squat to parallel, then explosively stand and throw the ball to a target ~9-10 feet up on the wall. Catch the rebound at chest height and flow into the next squat.

name: Wall Sit Variation with Heel Lift
description: Wall sit with alternating heel lifts — quad endurance + calf activation for dancers and ballet.
instructions_excerpt: Wall sit at 90° knee. Alternately lift one heel at a time (as in relevé) while holding the sit. Continue for 30-60 seconds.

name: Water-Polo Eggbeater Tread Sim
description: Dryland seated eggbeater drill — water-polo specific leg motion.
instructions_excerpt: Seated on edge of bench, legs in air. Circle each foot opposite the other (alternating breaststroke kick). 30-60s sets.

name: Weighted Pack Hike
description: Loaded hiking with a pack — the single most specific off-day session for any mountaineering or thru-hiking objective.
instructions_excerpt: Load a pack to 20-40% of bodyweight (start light). Walk uphill or on rolling terrain for 45-90 minutes at conversational effort. Prioritize steady cadence and even breathing over pace.

name: Weighted Vest Stair Repeats
description: Weighted-vest stair-repeat session — fell-running and OCR ascent specificity.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a 10-20 lb vest. Run or power-hike a long staircase up. Walk down. 8-12 reps.

name: Winter-Approach Pack-Carry Staircase
description: Loaded pack stair climb — approaches for winter and alpine objectives.
instructions_excerpt: Wear a 15-30 lb pack. Climb a stair or steep slope for 8-15 min at steady effort. Poles optional.

name: Yo-Yo Intermittent Intervals
description: Intermittent shuttle test-style conditioning — soccer/rugby/hockey-specific repeated-sprint capacity.
instructions_excerpt: Mark 20m shuttle. Run out, touch, return — then 10s recovery jog/walk. Repeat at target pace (~12-18 km/h progressing). 15-25 intervals.
